pages.text: Kiwano grows on a Kiwano Bush in the biome of a Warped Forest. When you eat it, you will get a Fire Resistance effect, but in return, you will also get a Poisoning effect. Kiwano can be used to make a set of armor that

pages.title: Kiwano items
pages.text: reduces fire damage and a set of tools that instantly melt the block you get.
